section.title: Super Agent
section.subtitle: Hand a one-line request to an agent that owns its own worktree; the result comes back as a ticket
field.repoPath.label: Default repository path
field.repoPath.help: The executor creates worktrees in this repository. Save it and the next ticket uses the new path.
field.prepareCommand.label: Workspace prepare command
field.prepareCommand.help: A command run in the worktree after it is created and before the worker starts, such as pnpm install. Leave it empty to skip. A failure fails the ticket at once with no automatic retry; it runs for at most 10 minutes.
field.confirmInferred.label: Wait for my confirmation on inferred candidates
field.confirmInferred.help: When on, a candidate the agent inferred from a chat or a pull request does not start work: it is listed under Pending until you accept it. Explicit requests are unaffected. It only makes a difference in the automatic accept mode.
field.evalMode.label: Assessment mode
field.evalMode.help: How inferred candidates (messages in a chat without @-mentioning the agent, and similar) are handled: observe records them only; automatic sends accepted ones to the pending list above or starts work directly, depending on the confirmation switch. Explicit requests bypass this setting and always start work.
field.evalMode.option.auto: Automatic (accepted candidates go to the pending list or start work)
field.evalTimeoutSeconds.label: Assessment timeout (seconds)
field.evalTimeoutSeconds.help: How long a pending inferred candidate may wait for its assessment (a model call) before it is recorded as unavailable. 30-600, default 120. Takes effect on the next pump tick; no restart needed.
field.maxWorkers.label: Maximum tickets running at once
field.maxWorkers.help: Concurrency limit, 1-16, default 2. Extra tickets queue for a free slot; save it and restart the host for it to take effect.
field.ticketTimeoutSeconds.label: Per-ticket timeout (seconds)
field.ticketTimeoutSeconds.help: A ticket still unfinished this many seconds after it was created has its worker stopped and is marked failed; 0 means no limit. Default 1800 (30 minutes).
field.githubRepository.label: GitHub repository
field.githubRepository.help: Write it as owner/name. Once set, mentioning the bot in that repository turns into a ticket; leave it empty to keep GitHub disconnected.
field.githubLogin.label: Bot's GitHub login
field.githubLogin.help: Used to skip comments the bot wrote itself. Getting it wrong raises no error: the bot's own replies are read as new requests and dispatched again.
field.githubAllowed.label: People allowed to dispatch
field.githubAllowed.help: GitHub logins, comma separated. Mentions from anyone else create no ticket: this is the authorization boundary, not a notification preference.
field.githubTokenEnv.label: Environment variable holding the token
field.githubTokenEnv.help: Reads GITHUB_TOKEN by default. The token never lands on disk or in the config file; to switch tokens, change this variable or restart the host.
field.feishuEnabled.label: Feishu source
field.feishuEnabled.help: Collect requests from Feishu chats and direct messages. Off by default; while off, no lark-cli process starts. Restart the host after changing it.
field.feishuCli.label: lark-cli path
field.feishuCli.help: Install it yourself (not bundled with the plugin): npm install -g @larksuite/cli (official repo github.com/larksuite/cli), then verify with lark-cli --version. Leave it empty to use lark-cli from PATH, or give an absolute path to pick a different build. When the CLI cannot be found the source does not start; the log says so once. Restart the host after changing it.
field.feishuChats.label: Chats to watch
field.feishuChats.help: Chat ids (starting with oc_), comma separated. Empty means no chats, and the source will not start. Restart the host after changing it.
field.feishuAllowed.label: Feishu users allowed to assign work
field.feishuAllowed.help: Feishu open_ids (starting with ou_), comma separated. Without this list every Feishu message is rejected as not on the list: messages arrive but no ticket is ever created. If you do not know your open_id, put any value in, send one message, and the host log prints the rejected id.
field.feishuDirect.label: Direct messages
field.feishuDirect.help: When on, direct messages to the bot also count as requests. Off by default: only group messages that mention it are read.
field.assessorModel.label: Model for assessment
field.assessorModel.help: Write it as provider/model. Empty means no model: only requests addressed to the agent are accepted. Once set, requests it is unsure about are judged by the model. Restart the host after changing it.
field.workerModel.label: Model for workers
field.workerModel.help: Write it as provider/model. Empty means workers follow the host's current route; once set, every ticket's worker uses this model, and the provider must already exist in the providers section of config.yaml. Restart the host after changing it.
field.workerBlockedCommands.label: Blocked commands for workers
field.workerBlockedCommands.help: Comma separated. Written into the worker's system prompt as a reminder. A reminder only, not enforcement and not a security boundary: an absolute path still runs. git and built-in tools are unaffected. Restart the host after changing it.
save.maxWorkersBad: The concurrency limit must be a number (1-16)
save.timeoutBad: The timeout must be a number of seconds (0 means no limit)
save.prepareCommandTooLong: The prepare command is too long (4000 characters at most)
save.githubRepositoryBad: The repository must look like owner/name
save.evalModeBad: The assessment mode must be one of: observe, automatic, off
save.evalTimeoutBad: The assessment timeout must be a number (30-600)
